responsibility: Owns the .loom directory and every file the CLI, the MCP server and the browser host read or write: inspection, initialization, discovery and path ownership, per-session workspace handles, output routing and installation, trusted baselines, workflow state, expected-revision writes, composition changes and their journal, the durable evidence store and published-contract resolution.
owns: Path identity: separator normalization, filesystem case rules, symlink and junction resolution, containment by path segment.
Disjointness of governed path sets across every discoverable descriptor.
Atomic per-file installation with a bundle manifest and a recoverable journal.
Reading policy, baselines and acceptance records from the trusted Git ref.
Workspace handles: an opaque workspaceId per session and model, with the watchers of the model, configuration and evidence paths that handle opened.
The federation journal of a change across repositories, its locks taken in canonical repository order.
boundary: No semantic rule of its own: every decision is delegated to the core.
Never stages, commits or updates a gitlink.
Never trusts candidate-supplied policy or acceptance.
There is no process-wide active workspace: a call that uses stored state names the handle of its own session, and a startup directory is only a discovery hint.
Initialization never replaces an existing .loom and never creates an acceptance record.

provides.name: init
provides.concurrency: Stages scaffolding then installs it; refuses when .loom exists.

provides.name: discover
provides.concurrency: Read-only walk of the declared boundary.

provides.name: resolveOwner
provides.concurrency: Read-only; a cached result is used only while its invalidation identity matches.

provides.name: loadWorkspace
provides.concurrency: Read-only.

provides.name: inspectWorkspace
provides.concurrency: Read-only: reads nothing above its boundary, walks no unrelated source, dependency or artifact tree, and returns the inspection digest an initialization names as its expectation.

provides.name: initializeWorkspace
provides.concurrency: Driven by the requested declaration: a dry run returns every file it would write and the inspection digest and writes nothing; applying needs that digest and the same declaration, reinspects under the lock, refuses a stale proposal and writes the scaffold atomically with a recovery journal for an interrupted write.

provides.name: sessionHandles
provides.concurrency: A handle exists only for the session that opened it; two sessions opening one model share its revision protocol and keep separate handles, activity and browser sessions; a workspaceId of another session is an unknown handle.

provides.name: openWorkspace
provides.concurrency: Opens a handle for the requesting session with read or edit access and returns the bounded summary at one revision vector; it changes no model.

provides.name: workspaceStatus
provides.concurrency: Read-only status of one handle of the requesting session: its revisions, resources, pending runs and next actions.

provides.name: closeWorkspace
provides.concurrency: Cancels or awaits the handle's owned runs, detaches its watchers, revokes its browser access and releases it; a close that leaves an owned resource is refused with the resource and its recovery.

provides.name: federationInspect
provides.concurrency: Read-only: the direct members with their pins, the roots each model claims, the missing inputs and the dependency graph.

provides.name: federationPlan
provides.concurrency: Writes nothing: an immutable proposal bound to the revision vector it was planned against.

provides.name: federationApply
provides.concurrency: Owner-local writes through the expected-revision and lock protocol, locks taken in canonical repository order and every write journaled; there is no atomic transaction across repositories, so a partly applied change stays visibly incomplete until recovery resumes it or restores the journal-owned writes that are still unchanged.

provides.name: federationCheck
provides.concurrency: Read-only resolution of one snapshot's closure; it manufactures no acceptance.

provides.name: federationPublish
provides.concurrency: Writes one immutable bundle; a release publication requires the configured acceptance and evidence, and a draft is never trusted as a release.

provides.name: federationJournal
provides.concurrency: One journal per applied proposal; a journal in recovery-required blocks further composed writes and composed readiness until recovery completes or restores it.

provides.name: workspaceLock
provides.concurrency: An exclusive lock file per written file, awaited without blocking the server, so a waiting write never stalls status, cancellation, other workspaces or browser events; a lock left by a process that no longer exists is taken over, and a lock not obtained in time is refused as unresolved-context. No model lock is held while native checks run.

provides.name: installOutputs
provides.concurrency: Per-file atomic replacement; an interrupted bundle stays visibly incomplete in the journal and the manifest.

provides.name: readTrustedBaseline
provides.concurrency: Reads committed content of the trusted ref only.

provides.name: readPolicy
provides.concurrency: Reads committed content of the trusted ref only.

provides.name: writeModel
provides.concurrency: The persistent mutation the CLI, the MCP server and the browser host share: the mutation expectation naming the model, configuration, policy and import revisions is rechecked under an exclusive lock file while writing; a stale write, a refused change and a dry run write nothing, and an unreadable configuration or a lock not obtained in time is refused as unresolved-context.

provides.name: writeState
provides.concurrency: Persists workflow state under the same expected-revision compare-and-swap as writeModel, rechecked under an exclusive lock file while writing; a stale write writes nothing, and an unreadable state or a lock not obtained in time is refused as unresolved-context. State carries no acceptance authority.

provides.name: evidenceStore
provides.concurrency: Append-only; records are content-addressed and never rewritten.

provides.name: resolvePublishedContracts
provides.concurrency: Reads explicitly pinned bundles only; never a network import.
